description: Secondary works and tzdb comments that pointed to sources. They are not citations: nothing in the atlas rests on them.

leads.title: tzdb 2025c, file europe: comments before the France rules and Zone Europe/Paris
leads.note: Pointed to the law of 14 March 1891 in the Journal officiel of 15 March 1891, the law of 9 March 1911 in the Journal officiel of 10 March 1911, Le Petit Journal of 11 March 1911 on the pneumatic clocks and the railway change, and the five-minute lag of railway clocks. All were read at the source before being cited.
